text: Because hedge fund losses are absorbed directly by a large and dispersed body of investors and their equity capital, private fund advisers are unlikely to trigger a systemic event, and their activity may even reduce market volatility.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Timothy A. Krause, Hedge Funds and Systemic Risk (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2748096
abstract: But some research suggests that private fund advisers are unlikely to trigger a systemic event because losses in hedge funds are directly absorbed by the multitude of investors and their equity capital and may actually reduce market volatility

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to funds financed by investor equity rather than short term debt
